scopeNote: CON0 normative candidate list, not a signed-off statement-level denominator. Source references identify code surfaces, not definitive proof. WCP is a separate non-normative axis. None of these values constitutes an OMG conformance claim.

requirements.title: Process and explicit creation; none start/end
Multiple incoming/outgoing flows without gateways
requirements.limitations: CON2 oracle covers an unconditional implicit split from an activity only; conditional flows leaving an activity are not covered. Implementation status left for reviewer.

requirements.title: Gateway default-flow and no-match failure
requirements.limitations: CON2 oracle covers exclusive gateway default flow and the no-route incident (ADR-0273); inclusive-gateway default/no-match not covered. Implementation status left for reviewer.

requirements.title: Model validation: reachability/scope/refs
requirements.limitations: `compiler/validation.go`. CON2 pins 12 located diagnostics (rule + element + severity), including the four sequence-flow shapes ADR-0547 refuses (start event with incoming flow, end event with outgoing flow, gateway default that is not the gateway's own outgoing flow, including a default naming another gateway's flow); 10 element-local refusals that still carry only rule "compile" and no element field (ADR-0547 part 2, not started); 2 non-blocking warnings. Stored definitions with the refused shapes reload unchanged per ADR-0177/ADR-0393.

requirements.title: Uncontrolled flow: one activity arrival per token, multiple outgoing flow, mixed conditional/unconditional
requirements.limitations: CON2 oracle: activity with two incoming flows and no gateway runs once per token, no synchronization. Implementation status left for reviewer.

requirements.title: Process completion: no tokens and no active activities, including boundary/event subprocess/MI
requirements.limitations: OMG §13.2; live and crash/replay proof outstanding
